76 Learn more about registering custom utilities in the [adding custom utilities documentation](/docs/adding-custom-styles#adding-custom-utilities). 77 78

79 @variant 80

81 82 Use the `@variant` directive to apply a Tailwind variant to styles in your CSS: 83 84 ```css 85 /* [!code filename:CSS] */ 86 .my-element { 87 background: white; 88 89 /* [!code highlight:4] */ 90 @variant dark { 91 background: black; 92 } 93 } 94 ``` 95 96 Learn more using variants in the [using variants documentation](/docs/adding-custom-styles#using-variants). 97 98

99 @custom-variant 100

101 102 Use the `@custom-variant` directive to add a custom variant in your project: 103 104 ```css 105 /* [!code filename:CSS] */ 106 @custom-variant theme-midnight (&:where([data-theme="midnight"] *)); 107 ``` 108 109 This lets you write utilities `theme-midnight:bg-black` and `theme-midnight:text-white`. 110 111 Learn more about adding custom variants in the [adding custom variants documentation](/docs/adding-custom-styles#adding-custom-variants). 112 113
